sections.h2: About half of PHP websites run a version with no security fixes

chart.title: Versions with no fixes still run on 53% of PHP sites
chart.sub: Share of PHP websites by PHP version, %, as of 22 August 2026.

sections.means: A little over half of PHP sites run a branch that the PHP project no longer patches.
sections.todo: Move off PHP 7 and 8.0 to 8.1 now, and plan the PHP 8.2 upgrade before 31 December 2026.

sections.h2: Most new WordPress flaws sit in plugins, not the core software

chart.title: Plugins account for 91% of 2025's new WordPress vulnerabilities
chart.sub: Share of the 11,334 new WordPress and add-on vulnerabilities found in 2025, %.

sections.means: Patchstack counted 11,334 new WordPress vulnerabilities in 2025, 42% more than in 2024, and 91% were in plugins.
sections.todo: Turn on automatic security updates for the CMS and plugins, and remove any plugin that is not used.

sections.means: CERT-In's 2022 breakdown counted 19,793 website defacements, and government sites hacked numbered 59, 42 and 50 in 2020, 2021 and 2022.
